_about: Ground-truth questions answerable ONLY by reading the care-protocol PDF (classes 6-7 in BENCHMARK_CHARTER.md). Structured-only arms (metric views, closure) cannot answer these; they need RAG over the PDF or a Page/graph that encodes the protocol. Facts are hand-verified against diabetes_care_protocol.html.

diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.question: Below what eGFR is metformin contraindicated?
For a diabetic aged 40-75 with no statin dispensed (an SPD gap), what does the protocol recommend?
diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.expected_fact: Start a moderate-to-high intensity statin after confirming no contraindication (pregnancy, active hepatic disease)

diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.question: What defines a controlled blood pressure reading for BPD?
What is the cardiorenal escalation for diabetes with CKD and heart failure?
diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.expected_fact: Ensure statin, ACE inhibitor or ARB, and an SGLT2 inhibitor if eGFR >= 20; monitor A1c every 3 months

diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.question: At what uACR level should an ACE inhibitor or ARB be started?
How often should HbA1c be checked for a poorly controlled patient?
diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.expected_fact: Every 3 months (A1c > 9% is poorly controlled); every 6 months if at goal

diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.question: Which drug classes are contraindicated in pregnancy per the protocol?
diabetes_care_protocol.pdf.expected_fact: Statins and ACE inhibitors/ARBs are contraindicated in pregnancy
